instructions: Judge each exact expression independently under the supplied architecture profile and rubric. The supplied scenario contract and code are evidence. Do not infer omitted inputs or effects. Cite exact supplied text for both axes. No author proposals or provider predictions are supplied.

opportunity.instructions: Judge only the exact target expression under the supplied architecture profile. Supporting fragments explain inputs and effects; they are not additional candidates. A helper call is judged using its supplied implementation. A factory assembly is judged as the selected expression, not as each lambda separately. Do not infer omitted context. A durable product/domain rule can qualify with one use. Choose eligible when this same decision benefits from a named, addressable, observable Specification. Choose excluded for technical mechanics without a distinct product decision, or explicit evidence that a Specification already owns this SAME decision. Unrelated Specifications, imports alone and ordinary helper names do not establish ownership. Choose needs_review when material ambiguity prevents reliable judgment.

criteria.eligible: This exact expression expresses a durable product/domain decision suitable for a named, addressable, observable Specification; one use is sufficient.
criteria.excluded: Technical mechanics or coordination without a distinct product decision, or the same decision is explicitly already owned by a Specification.
criteria.needs_review: Evidence is materially ambiguous or insufficient; unknown, not an exclusion.

concern_kind.instructions: Independently classify the primary responsibility expressed by the exact target expression, using the supplied profile and context. Supporting declarations are evidence, not additional classification targets. Product/domain integrity and authority rules can be policy even when enforced through validation or composed as an existing Specification. A mechanical guard inside a factory assembly does not by itself determine the primary responsibility of the whole selected assembly. Use unknown for material ambiguity. Do not infer omitted dependencies.

criteria.policy: A durable product/domain rule, authority, trust, evidence, eligibility, or lifecycle decision.
criteria.mechanics: Parsing, representation, I/O, adaptation, or technical enforcement WITHOUT a distinct product decision.
criteria.variant_behavior: Dispatch over domain variants such as enum cases, types, or platforms.
criteria.unknown: The supplied evidence does not support a reliable concern-kind label.
